vsl_script.text:
COMMAND VSL. Target length 3 to 6 minutes. Adon or CC on camera, landscape, eye level, quiet room. Oasis Studio adds captions, b-roll, the screen recordings named below and the OASIS end card.
Rule for the whole video: say no number, result or client story that is not on the page. Prices are said exactly as the page shows them. Every screen recording uses a synthetic test lead, never a real customer's details.

[BEAT 1. HOOK, 0:00 to 0:20]
On camera: You are on a job. Your phone buzzes with a new enquiry. By the time you call back that evening, they have hired whoever answered first. Leads go cold while you work.

[BEAT 2. WHO THIS IS FOR, AND WHO IT IS NOT FOR]
On camera: This is for service businesses doing roughly $10K to $75K a month, where the owner is still the one chasing every lead.
It is not for you if you are just starting out or want to build it all yourself. PROTOCOL is a better start. And if you are not ready for any of it, the free community is linked below this video.

[BEAT 3. WHY IT KEEPS HAPPENING]
On camera: It keeps happening because follow-up has no owner. It lives in your inbox, your texts and your head, and nothing chases it unless you do. Another app does not fix that. A system that does the chasing does.

[BEAT 4. WHAT WE DO ABOUT IT, SHOWN IN THE COMMAND CENTER]
Screen recording: a test lead fills in a form.
Voice over: Here is your follow-up and booking running without you. Watch a lead arrive.
Screen recording: the automatic reply going out.
Voice over: It gets an answer.
Screen recording: the call appearing in Schedule.
Voice over: And the call lands on the calendar. Three steps: book the call and show us where work slips. We set it up around your business, or you set it up yourself. Then the follow-up keeps going without you.

[BEAT 5. WHAT YOU GET, PRICES SAID OUT LOUD]
On camera, matching the page word for word:
OS DIY, $497 a month, no setup fee. You configure it yourself.
OS Turnkey, done for you, $2,500 setup plus $997 a month, or the setup in two payments of $1,400. The 7-day setup clock starts when your onboarding vault is 100% submitted.
Managed operating partner, $5,000 setup plus $2,500 to $3,500 a month.
Every monthly plan: cancel any time from your account, no cancellation fee.
Note for the recording: once Adon picks one number for each range, say that number, and update this script and the page together.

[BEAT 6. PROOF]
No permissioned examples are confirmed yet, so the proof is the product working: the beat 4 recording, start to finish, no cuts in the middle.

[BEAT 7. CALL TO ACTION]
On camera: Book your discovery call below. It is 45 minutes. You talk first, then we show you the Command Center set up around what you told us. Not ready? The free community is linked right below this video.

items.title: Leads go cold while you are on the job
items.body: A new enquiry comes in while you are with a customer. By the time you call back, they have hired someone who answered first.

items.title: Follow-up lives in your head
items.body: Quotes, callbacks and reminders sit in your inbox, your texts and a notebook. Nothing chases them unless you do.

items.title: Booking takes a string of messages
items.body: Back and forth about times before anyone is on the calendar, and some people give up halfway.

items.title: You bought tools nobody uses
items.body: Another app with another login. It was supposed to save time and became one more thing to manage.

items.title: The back office eats your evenings
items.body: Admin happens after hours, because the day belongs to the customers.

sections.title: Set up for you, or by you
sections.lede: Every plan runs on the OASIS Command Center. The difference is who sets it up and who runs it with you.

items.title: OS DIY: $497 a month, no setup fee
items.body: The OASIS Command Center platform, provisioned for your business, and you configure it yourself. For owners comfortable with software. Cancel any time from your account; no cancellation fee.

items.title: OS Turnkey, done for you: $2,500 setup + $997 a month
items.body: We configure the Command Center around how your business already runs. You fill in the onboarding vault (your logins, documents and channels), and the 7-day setup clock starts when it is 100% submitted. Prefer to split the setup? Two payments of $1,400. Cancel the monthly plan any time from your account; no cancellation fee.

items.title: Managed operating partner: $5,000 setup + $2,500 to $3,500 a month
items.body: For established businesses that want a dedicated team running the system with them, with a weekly audit. Cancel any time from your account; no cancellation fee.

sections.title: A bonus for starting on the call

items.title: Expedited VIP vault bonus
items.body: Offered to owners who decide to start at the end of the discovery call. We walk you through what it includes on the call.

items.q: What happens on the discovery call?
items.a: It is a 45-minute video call. For the first part you talk and we listen: how leads come in, where they stall, and what a good week looks like for you. Then we share a screen and walk through the Command Center set up around what you told us. If it is a fit, you can start on the call. If it is not, we will tell you.

First, book the call and show us where work slips. Then we set up the Command Center around your business, or you set it up yourself on OS DIY. After that, new leads get an answer, calls land on your calendar and the follow-up keeps going without you chasing it.

items.q: Which plan is right for me?
items.a: If you are comfortable configuring software, OS DIY. If you would rather hand it over, Turnkey. If you want a team running it alongside you every week, the managed partner. We will recommend one on the call.

items.q: What do you need from me to get started?
items.a: For Turnkey, your onboarding vault: you add the logins, sign the documents and choose your channels in one place. Setup starts when it is complete.

items.q: What if the setup fee is too much right now?
items.a: Turnkey's setup can be split into two payments of $1,400. You can also start on OS DIY at $497 a month with no setup fee, or join the VIP mastermind at $97 a month and build alongside us first.
Cancel any time from your account. There is no cancellation fee.

That is fine. Join the free OASIS community on Telegram, build alongside us, and come back when the timing is right. It costs nothing. Join here: https://oasisai.work/go/community?form=command&t=oasis-ai-cc
